justification: Inspected `byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/implementation/attribute/AnnotationAppender.java`, `FieldAttributeAppender.java`, `MethodAttributeAppender.java`, `TypeAttributeAppender.java`, `RecordComponentAttributeAppender.java`, and `byte-buddy-dep/src/test/java/net/bytebuddy/implementation/attribute/AnnotationAppenderForTypeAnnotationsTest.java`. `ForTypeAnnotations` is a focused inner visitor with 4 state fields and a small set of factory/visitor methods, depending mainly on `AnnotationAppender`, `AnnotationValueFilter`, `TypeDescription.Generic`, `TypeList.Generic`, and `TypeReference`. Its incoming use is limited to four production appender classes and one dedicated test class, which is not strong enough fan-in/fan-out evidence for hub-like modularization.
